critical_code_review_comments: pages.json canonical URL for /bridal-makeup-Bangalore uses mixed-case 'Bangalore' path segment which is case-sensitive in some routers/SEO tools - consider lowercasing the slug for consistency with all other slugs.

RichBody.jsx does not include a fallback when body.sections is undefined; safe currently because pageBodies always defines it, but a defensive guard would prevent runtime errors if a slug is added to pages.json without a matching body entry.
